summary: Sibanye Stillwater Limited filed a routine Form 6-K with the SEC covering a report dated 7 October 2026, executed by Chief Financial Officer Charl Keyter. The submission contains only a cover page, signature block, and an exhibit index listing one market release as Exhibit 99.1; the excerpt itself is dominated by encoded image data and discloses no transaction, stake, price, premium, or strategic action. No special-situation event is evidenced. Because no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics appear, this is classified as a non-special-situation filing.
